minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, April 17, 2024

  ACTION MINUTES
  “see items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at: 10:00 AM on Wednesday, April 17th, 2024.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan,
  and Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: Jenny Jolly

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community
  Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, March 20th, 2024, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Valerie Smith, CTRI Behavioral Health. She provided information
  regarding the services offered by CTRI (Community Transitional Research
  Institute). They are offering 8 free sessions of mental health therapy for free. No
  insurance needed. Must make an appointment in advance. The sessions will be
  held at the La Verne Community Center for La Verne residents only.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 26 participants per week
  in March.

  Meals on Wheels: 655 meals served to La Verne recipients in the month of
  March.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through April 17th, 2024, was
  $27.80. Deposit of $403.75. The average attendance for March/April was 49
  players per week.

5. Account Balance: $3,419.96.

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for March except for Bridge and
  Bingo.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: Still in Spring Session. May 9th is registration for summer/fall
  classes.

8. Aging Next: 5 La Verne residents were served in March.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Closed for roof repair on the south end of building. Friday,
  April 19th.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Wednesday, April 24th – Excursion, Alpacas and Old Town Temecula, 8:30AM-5:15PM.
  - Friday, April 26th – Senior Dinner Dance, Guac N Roll, 5:00PM-8:00PM.
  - Wednesday, May 8th– Excursion, Santa Monica, 3rd Street Promenade, The Pier and
  Farmers Market, 8:30AM-4:30PM.
  - Monday, May 13th–Movie Matinee, The Upside, 12:30PM.

11. Public Comments: Guest- Lorraine Missick, Need Volunteers for Pomona Valley
  Hospital. Asked if she could setup a table camp in the Community Center to
  recruit volunteers. Bette gave an update on gathering information for having
  Bunco at the Center. She will provide information to Armando to submit for
  approval by the Community Center Director. Ed asked about referring a new
  member for the SAC. Yvonne informed us that all applications are on hold until
  former notice. May 6th is the City Council Meeting to recognize Older Americans.

12. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:55AM. The next meeting will be on
  Wednesday, May 15th, 2024 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:

  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
